text:
Thank you for returning the agreement. We compared it with the version we sent. A few points need to change before we can countersign:

Clause 4.4 (Fee Adjustments): We accept this change.

Clause 5 (Service Levels): We can raise the service credit cap to 15% of the monthly fee.

Clause 6 (Customer Data): We can keep Customer Data available for export for ninety days after termination.

Please send a corrected copy with the points above and we will countersign promptly.
